style: A warm, timeless Anatolian folktale told beside a fire at night. Natural phrasing, intimate cinematic delivery, gentle wit, never cartoonish. Leave a small breath at the end of each line.

speakers.name: Narrator
speakers.style: An inviting older storyteller with a low, textured voice and unhurried clarity.

speakers.name: Cook
speakers.style: A proud, theatrical market cook; indignant but believable.

speakers.name: Traveler
speakers.style: A weary, decent young traveler, embarrassed and softly defensive.

speakers.name: Nasreddin
speakers.style: An older man with dry warmth, patient authority, and a smile just audible in his voice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One cold evening in Aksehir, a hungry traveler stopped beside a cook's cauldron.
lines.direction: Quietly draw the listener into the scene.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He had only a piece of dry bread. So he held it over the fragrant steam, then ate it.
lines.direction: Tenderly, with sympathy for the traveler.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.text: Thief! You enjoyed the smell of my soup. You must pay me.
lines.direction: A sudden accusation, loud and offended.

lines.speaker: Traveler
lines.text: But I took nothing. I only warmed my bread in the steam.
lines.direction: Startled, sincere, and a little afraid of the gathering crowd.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Their quarrel drew a crowd, and at its edge stood Nasreddin Hodja.
lines.direction: Let the arrival feel quietly important.

lines.speaker: Nasreddin
lines.text: Good cook, you ask payment for the smell of soup?
lines.direction: Courteous and genuinely curious, concealing the joke.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.text: Of course! A pleasure has its price.
lines.direction: Certain of victory, with smug emphasis on price.

lines.speaker: Nasreddin
lines.text: Then give me the traveler's coin purse.
lines.direction: Calm, decisive, as though issuing a fair judgment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Hodja raised the purse beside the cook's ear and shook it. Chink. Chink.
lines.direction: Build gentle suspense, then make the two final words crisp and separate.

lines.speaker: Cook
lines.text: I heard the money. Now hand it over.

lines.speaker: Nasreddin
lines.text: The sound of money is fair payment for the smell of soup.
lines.direction: Deliver the judgment with serene warmth and dry comic precision.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The crowd laughed. The traveler kept his coins, and the cook was left holding only the echo.
lines.direction: A delighted, gentle ending; linger slightly on echo.
